object_description: compact four-storey solitaire with an access cascade rising to a rooftop pitch
geometry_property: delicate almost fully glazed steel facade
design_condition: the volume terminates the public space between the two squares as an identity-forming cornerstone, generating a new neighbourhood square on the north side and taking the footbridge into the building

positive: The volume forms an end to the public space and creates an identity-forming cornerstone
The urban positioning creates a new neighbourhood square usable independently of the sports field
The footbridge becomes part of the building and is integrated into the urban space in a natural way
As a compact four-storey solitaire it provides important open spaces on both sides
An access cascade running through the building connects all floors from the playground to the rooftop pitch
External staircases allow evacuation and access to the rooftop pitch from outside
The communal rooms are functionally arranged on the ground floor and can be easily combined
The kindergarten has a direct connection to the footbridge and the clusters share cluster halls on each floor
The architectural expression of the steel building recalls the industrial history of the site
The delicate facade is deliberately differentiated from the expression of the surrounding buildings
The almost full-surface glazing allows plenty of daylight into the interior
The steel structure with columns, beams and trapezoidal soffits is shown openly
Space efficiency and short distances support an economical solution
A conceptually convincing contribution in urban planning and in the footbridge connection
negative: Floor-to-ceiling staircase offsets can only be bridged barrier-free by a lift connection
The fixed grid of the floor plans only partially allows further subdivision of the rooms
The ball catcher on the roof has a height of less than four metres
The extensive glazing must be questioned in terms of energy efficiency
The proposed statics with ceilings under 20 cm appear undersized
Reworking time is longer due to the necessary fire protection measures
Questions remain unanswered regarding the energy-related construction solutions
The direct connection of the footbridge exit to the facade is not unproblematic for operations
The concept carries many tasks likely to result in major restrictions as described
